title: ValiText - a Unified Validation Framework for Computational Text-Based Measures of Social Constructs

bias_targets.methodology: The paper demonstrates its proposed validation framework by evaluating machine learning models designed to measure sexism in social media comments (using a case study from Samory et al., 2019). The methodology involves feature importance analysis (inspecting predictive unigrams), error analysis across data groupings to identify systematic misclassifications, and comparing model outputs against human-annotated test sets.
